properties.title: Reef aggregation index bindings (AF_i)
properties.description: Per-taxon reef aggregation index bindings carried by the canonical reef-biomass equation record. Three expansion bindings (Mytilus edulis, Buccinum undatum, Asterias rubens) provide AF_i for the index `i` in the reef-biomass equation.

experimentInput.name: Reef aggregation index bindings
experimentInput.description: Per-taxon reef aggregation index (Mytilus edulis, Buccinum undatum, Asterias rubens). Reusable across any experiment that consumes this indicator.

provenance.note: AF_i values 12.0 / 3.5 / 5.0 are ILLUSTRATIVE and NOT taken from any published source. Verified via WebFetch against Degraer et al. 2020: that paper reports only one quantitative figure for blue mussel — `biomass can increase 4,000-fold compared to the biomass originally present in the sediments` at turbine-footprint scale (citing Rumes et al. 2013) — and gives NO numeric biomass enhancement for Buccinum undatum or Asterias rubens. The 4,000-fold figure is at turbine-footprint scale (areal-integrated) and is not directly the per-m² coefficient AF_i in the reef-biomass equation.

primarySource.citation: Degraer, S., D.A. Carey, J.W.P. Coolen, Z.L. Hutchison, F. Kerckhof, B. Rumes, J. Vanaverbeke. 2020. Offshore wind farm artificial reefs affect ecosystem structure and functioning: A synthesis. Oceanography 33(4):48–57.
primarySource.supportingFigure: Mytilus edulis biomass increase quoted in body text, citing Rumes et al. 2013.

nearestAuthoritativeSource.note: Real AF_i derivation requires paired before/after or inside/outside biomass observations on a real wind farm — Belwind, Thornton Bank, WindFloat Atlantic etc. — aggregated against control sites. OBIS exposes such occurrence records when monitoring programmes publish to it. No single REST call returns the dimensionless AF_i itself.

provenance.verificationGap: Degraer 2020 numeric quote verified. AF_i values in this example NOT calibrated to that source.
